title: C4OS Grill Question 026 - Disabled Plugin Prompt Tags

questions.label: What happens when a prompt tag references a disabled plugin or plugin resource?
questions.help: Recommended: show the disabled result but block insertion, with a Settings link to enable the plugin. This keeps discovery useful without silently enabling plugins.
options: Show disabled result but block insertion with link to enable plugin
Allow insertion, then fail at send time
Offer to enable the plugin inline from the tag menu

questions.label: What happens when the plugin is enabled but dependency-blocked?
questions.help: Recommended: show dependency-blocked state and block insertion until dependencies are fixed.
options: Show dependency-blocked state and block insertion
Allow insertion, then fail at send time

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether disabled skills, missing files, missing projects, or unavailable runtime commands should behave the same way.
